decision: The find_dependencies route is wired to the Parent Atlas source-index and graph-artifact adapters with no Neo4j fallback. The checked-in structural edge plan is incomplete, contains no admitted IMPORTS/CALLS edge set, and has a mismatched workspace revision; therefore the actual graph lookup remains unresolved until its source cohort and edge producer are refreshed and admitted. Do not claim live dependencies from fixtures. Use PageRank only to order BFS results and CUDA only as an optional parity-checked executor.
